title: Which seven digit number has the longest name?
description: The name of a seven digit number is built from the lakh part, the thousand part and the last three digits. Each part is made as long as possible, and the letters are added. The sum is checked against the name of the biggest candidate.
teaching_notes: One idea: split a number name into its parts and make each part as long as possible. Watch for students who pick the biggest number, which is not the one with the longest name.

source: Figure it Out, Q2 (the longest name)
video_script.why: The child can read and write number names in lakhs and thousands, and now counts the letters of a name part by part.
video_script.substitution: Split the name into the lakh part, the thousand part and the last three digits; make each part as long as it can be; add the letters.
video_script.anchor: the name of 10,30,285 written in words, with its three parts marked
video_script.payoff_line: Make each part of the name as long as it can be

final_answer.value: The largest number of letters is 61, for example 77,77,777
final_answer.spoken: the largest number of letters is sixty one, for example seventy seven lakhs seventy seven thousand seven hundred seventy seven

maths_rules: ten lakhs thirty thousand two hundred eighty five: ten 3, lakhs 5, thirty 6, thousand 8, two 3, hundred 7, eighty 6, five 4; total 42
lakhs 5, thousand 8, hundred 7; seventy 7 and three, seven, eight 5 each
longest two digit name has 12 letters, for example seventy seven
lakh part 12 + 5 = 17; thousand part 12 + 8 = 20; last three digits (seven hundred seventy seven) 12 + 12 = 24
17 + 20 + 24 = 61, reached by 77,77,777; 81 seven digit numbers reach 61
video_script.design: One idea: a name is a sum of its parts, so make each part as long as possible. The name of the book's number stays in the anchor band; the working band builds the three parts. No hard clear.
open_questions: The book says the name of 10,30,285 has 43 letters; counting the letters gives 42. The answer key's 60 for 77,77,777 uses the singular lakh; with lakhs, as the question writes it, the count is 61.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>This is a question from your book.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The number ten lakh thirty thousand two hundred eighty five has a name with forty two letters.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Its name has three parts, the lakhs, the thousands and the last three digits.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>Which seven digit number has a name with the most letters?

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>The letters in a number name are the letters of its three parts added together.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The words lakhs, thousand and hundred have five, eight and seven letters.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Given, a seven digit name made of a lakh part, a thousand part and the last three digits.

beats.on_screen: To find: the 7 digit number whose name has the most letters

marks.m1: the find line is written under the given line

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>We have to find the number whose name has the most letters.

beats.on_screen: Step 1: longest two digit name: seventy 7 letters + three, seven or eight 5 letters = 12 letters, for example seventy seven

marks.m1: seventy is written with 7 under it
marks.m2: three, seven and eight are written with 5 under each
marks.m3: seventy seven is written with 12 under it

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step one, find the longest two digit name.
The word seventy has seven letters.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The words three, seven and eight have five letters each.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A name like seventy seven has twelve letters.

beats.on_screen: Step 2: lakh part = 12 + 5 = 17 letters; thousand part = 12 + 8 = 20 letters
narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step two, the lakh part is a two digit name and the word lakhs.
Twelve plus five makes seventeen letters.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The thousand part is a two digit name and the word thousand.
Twelve plus eight makes twenty letters.

beats.on_screen: Step 3: last three digits: seven hundred = 5 + 7 = 12 letters; seventy seven = 12 letters; together 12 + 12 = 24 letters
narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step three, the last three digits are a hundreds name and a two digit name.
Seven hundred has twelve letters.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Seventy seven also has twelve letters.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Together they make twenty four letters.

beats.on_screen: Step 4: check: 17 + 20 + 24 = 61 letters, for the name of 77,77,777; the book's number had 42

marks.m2: the name of 77,77,777 is written under it
marks.m3: 42 is written beside the book's number for comparison

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step four, add the three parts, seventeen, twenty and twenty four.
That makes sixty one letters.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>This is the name of seventy seven lakhs seventy seven thousand seven hundred seventy seven.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>It is much longer than the forty two letters in the book's number.

beats.on_screen: Answer: The largest number of letters is 61, for example 77,77,777
narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Make each part of the name as long as it can be.
The largest number of letters is sixty one.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>An example is seventy seven lakhs seventy seven thousand seven hundred seventy seven.
